title: Carbon
whatThisFileIs: CARBON, IBM'S DESIGN SYSTEM, AS A DEDICATED CATALOGUE (owner, 2026-10-25). The entries are the Carbon Web Components the package already ships; the designer selects this system in the ingest and the tool applies Carbon’s type — IBM Plex — when it stands.
description: IBM Carbon Design System catalogue for the ingest: the cds-* web components of @carbon/web-components v2.
